summary: Recommend changing the current D06 record to NOT READY pending bounded documentation and advisory-evidence repairs; preserve the core architecture, disclose the Codex-only/non-cross-provider limitation and unresolved dissent, then restore READY only after durable rechecks, leaving runtime proof to a separate implementation track.

findings.claim: The current READY label outruns the supplemental panel evidence state and should be suspended until the review chain and named document gaps are repaired.
The session is durable but its downstream context grants and relied-on reports are not immutable, digest-bound protocol evidence, so it cannot yet substantiate staged isolation or complete replay.
The all-Codex roster provides role separation but no provider-family diversity or independent cross-provider corroboration.
The planned production-proof matrix must add negative route tests for every forbidden semantic-recovery action before D06 readiness is restored.
